t: Interior and exterior, water-based, primer / sealer. Adheres to all surfaces without sanding. Blocks stains, permanently sealing graffiti, grease spots, tar and asphalt, indoors and out. Low odour application and conveniently quick-drying with excellent adhesion to even glossy surfaces. Contains a biocide that protects the dried coating against fungal degradation. Dry in 30 minutes. Recoat in 60 minutes.
